evals.prompt: Keep me informed of best practices in marketing in the IFM industry.
evals.expected_output: Should enter Brief mode, load weekly-scan.md, and produce the brief template: one thing that matters, max 5 stealable practices each with IFM reason + Vixxo implication + this-week action + source, plus hype to ignore. Should not give generic SaaS/consumer tactics without IFM translation. Should attempt Profound if relevant and say so if not connected. Should not send outbound messages.
assertions: Uses Brief mode / weekly scan template
Limits practices and includes Vixxo implication plus an action
Translates or rejects generic marketing hype

evals.prompt: Make me a marketing genius in IFM. Start teaching.
evals.expected_output: Should enter Coach mode, start curriculum module 1 (category/shelf), teach briefly with an IFM example and a common failure, then give one drill. Should not dump all 12 modules. Should offer the next module.
assertions: Starts with category/shelf not a random tactics dump
Does not present the entire curriculum at once
Stays IFM-specific vs generic growth hacking

evals.prompt: Review this LinkedIn ad: 'Vixxo is the one-stop shop for seamless facility solutions. Book a demo today. We care more than the big guys.'
evals.expected_output: Should enter Critique mode, score against the IFM copy test, call out clichés (one-stop shop, seamless, we care more), missing alternative/proof/committee, and rewrite the ad for a facilities + procurement pair with a stage-matched CTA. Should flag proof gaps instead of inventing metrics.
assertions: Scores or systematically tests the copy
Does not invent customer metrics or quotes

evals.prompt: We need an AEO campaign so ChatGPT recommends us for national restaurant facilities management.
evals.expected_output: Should apply IFM laws then route to vixxo-profound-aeo rather than inventing visibility scores. Should name the buyer job and proof required. Should not execute a HubSpot clone workflow inside this skill alone.
assertions: Does not fabricate AI visibility data
Frames restaurant/multi-site IFM not generic SEO
Names proof or enablement, not only 'write blogs'
